name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering

description: baseline: current prompt image handling before fixing slash/skill path parsing and display-path elision

asi.hypothesis: Establish baseline for image attachment prompt handling using generalized local-path and slash/skill scenarios.
baseline_failures: unquoted image path with spaces after /skill is not rendered
no display prompt sanitizer to hide local image path text

description: fix prompt image path parsing and hide rendered local image paths from display prompt

asi.hypothesis: Require real files for prompt image paths, scan image extensions for the first existing path prefix so slash/skill text cannot swallow unquoted spaced paths, and sanitize display text after extracting thumbnails.
asi.result: All prompt image attachment regression checks pass; primary failures dropped from 4 to 0.
asi.user_visible_effect: A pasted/attached image path like /var/.../clipboard.png is rendered as an image tile and removed from the hover prompt text instead of showing as raw temp-path clutter.

description: confirmation rerun of kept prompt image fix; metric tied best with no code changes

asi.hypothesis: Check that the zero-failure result is stable across a second run.
asi.result: All 8 regression checks passed again.
asi.rollback_reason: No code change and primary metric tied the kept best, so this is a confirmation-only discard.
asi.next_action_hint: Look for additional real attachment edge cases, especially file URLs, duplicate direct+path images, and display sanitization punctuation.

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (expanded path edge cases)

description: baseline for expanded image-path workload: shell-escaped spaced paths still fail

asi.hypothesis: Expand the benchmark to generalized image path forms (file URLs, shell-escaped spaces, parenthesized paths) to avoid overfitting to a single /var clipboard path.
asi.result: Expanded workload found one remaining edge case: POSIX shell-escaped paths with spaces do not render or sanitize.
asi.failing_case: A prompt containing /tmp/Screen\\ Shot.png should unescape to /tmp/Screen Shot.png before existence/MIME checks, but current extraction truncates at the escaped spaces.

description: support doubled/backslash-escaped prompt image paths with spaces

asi.hypothesis: Prompt text can contain shell-escaped local image paths; normalizing one or more backslashes before escaped characters should recover the real path and remove the raw escaped path from hover text.
asi.result: Expanded 11-check workload now passes with failures 1 -> 0.
asi.implementation_note: Changed POSIX prompt path unescaping from a single backslash to one-or-more backslashes before escapable characters, covering normal shell-escaped paths and double-escaped clipboard strings.

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (CLI file-tag cases)

description: baseline for CLI image file-tag workload: duplicate thumbnail count and leftover markup fail

asi.hypothesis: CLI/file-argument image attachments can include both evt.images and <file name="/path/image.png"></file> text; pi-island should avoid duplicate thumbnails and hide the file tag markup in the hover prompt.
asi.result: New 14-check workload has two failures: direct image plus matching file tag counts as two thumbnails, and display sanitization leaves '<file name= ></file>' after path removal.
failing_cases: direct ImageContent + matching image <file name> tag count=2 instead of 1
normalizePromptForDisplay removes only the path inside the tag, leaving empty file markup

description: dedupe CLI image file tags and hide image file markup in prompt display

asi.hypothesis: Image file tags generated by pi CLI/file arguments should be treated as attachment metadata: if direct image payloads are already present, their matching file-tag fallback paths should not add duplicate thumbnails, and image file tags should be removed entirely from hover prompt text.
asi.result: CLI file-tag workload passes: failures 2 -> 0 across 14 generalized prompt-image checks.
asi.implementation_note: Added image <file name=...></file> detection, removed whole image tags in normalizePromptForDisplay, and skipped the first matching file-tag fallback paths when direct ImageContent payloads already account for those attachments.

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (clean wrapper display)

description: baseline for clean wrapper display workload: path removal leaves empty wrappers

asi.hypothesis: After local image path removal, hover prompt display can leave wrapper clutter such as empty parentheses or angle brackets around where the path was.
asi.result: New 15-check workload has two failures: parenthesized path displays as '( )' and angle-bracketed path displays as '< >'.

description: remove empty path wrappers from sanitized prompt display

asi.hypothesis: Dropping empty balanced wrappers after image path/tag elision will produce cleaner hover prompt text without affecting thumbnail extraction.
asi.result: Clean-wrapper workload passes: failures 2 -> 0 across 15 prompt-image checks.
asi.implementation_note: normalizePromptForDisplay now removes empty (), [], {}, and <> after local image paths and image file tags are stripped.

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (markdown image syntax)

description: baseline for markdown image syntax workload: thumbnails render but hover display keeps markdown clutter

asi.hypothesis: Users may paste Markdown image syntax with local image paths; pi-island should render those paths as thumbnails and turn the hover prompt into clean text using the alt label rather than leaving Markdown punctuation.
asi.result: New 17-check workload has two display failures. Image extraction already works (count=1/images=1), but display text keeps `![alt]` or `![alt]( )`.
failing_cases: `see ![bug screenshot](/tmp/image.png)` displays as `see![bug screenshot] before fixing`
`see ![space shot](</tmp/Screen Shot.png>)` displays as `see![space shot]( ) now`

description: clean markdown image syntax in prompt hover display while preserving alt text

asi.hypothesis: Markdown image syntax with local paths should be treated as an image attachment plus optional alt-text label in the hover prompt.
asi.result: Markdown image workload passes: failures 2 -> 0 across 17 prompt-image checks.
asi.implementation_note: normalizePromptForDisplay now replaces image Markdown whose target resolves to a local image path with its trimmed alt text before generic path/tag elision runs.

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (markdown links and paren filenames)

description: baseline for markdown local-image links and parenthesized filenames: display cleanup leaves markdown brackets

asi.hypothesis: Markdown local-image references can be normal links or include parentheses in filenames; display cleanup should preserve clean label text while thumbnail extraction handles the path.
asi.result: New 19-check workload has two display failures. Thumbnail extraction works, but markdown image filenames with parentheses leave `![alt]` and markdown links leave `[label]`.
failing_cases: `![paren shot](/tmp/Screen Shot (1).png)` displays as `see![paren shot] now`
`[linked screenshot](/tmp/image.png)` displays as `see [linked screenshot] before fixing`

description: clean markdown local-image links and parenthesized image filenames in hover display

asi.hypothesis: Using path-match based Markdown cleanup should handle both normal Markdown links to local images and image targets whose filenames contain closing punctuation, while preserving useful label/alt text.
asi.result: Markdown link/paren-filename workload passes: failures 2 -> 0 across 19 prompt-image checks.
asi.implementation_note: Replaced target-regex-only Markdown image cleanup with a helper that finds resolved local image path matches, recognizes the surrounding !?[label](<path>) wrapper, and replaces the whole wrapper with the trimmed label.

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (duplicate markdown refs)

description: baseline for duplicate markdown local-image refs: deduped path cleanup leaves second wrapper

asi.hypothesis: Duplicate Markdown references to the same local image should still clean every Markdown wrapper in hover display while keeping thumbnail de-dupe.
asi.result: New 20-check workload has one display failure: extraction/count de-dupes the image correctly, but display cleanup only handles one Markdown wrapper because path matches are de-duped by resolved path.
asi.failing_case: `compare ![before](/tmp/a.png) and ![after](/tmp/a.png)` displays as `compare before and![after]` with count=1/images=1.

description: clean all duplicate markdown wrappers while preserving thumbnail de-dupe

asi.hypothesis: Display-only Markdown cleanup should process every local-image path occurrence, while extraction for thumbnails should still de-dupe by resolved path.
asi.result: Duplicate Markdown refs workload passes: failures 1 -> 0 across 20 prompt-image checks.
asi.implementation_note: extractPromptImagePathMatches now supports opts.dedupe=false with span-level duplicate suppression; normalizeMarkdownLocalImageReferencesForDisplay uses it so repeated references to the same resolved image path all get cleaned, but normalizePromptImages still uses the default de-duped extraction for thumbnail count.

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (relative local paths)

description: baseline for relative local path workload: initial relative-to-temp case already passes

asi.hypothesis: Explicit relative local image paths should render as thumbnails and be hidden from hover text, matching pi's cwd-relative tool behavior.
asi.result: Initial relative-path workload reported 0 failures, but the relative-to-/var test may be weak because the extractor can match an absolute suffix inside ../../var paths.
asi.next_action_hint: Strengthen the workload with a cwd-contained ./relative image path so success requires true relative-path extraction rather than absolute suffix matching.

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (cwd-relative paths)

description: baseline for cwd-relative image paths: explicit ./ path is not recognized

asi.hypothesis: Cwd-relative local image paths should render as thumbnails and disappear from hover text, not only absolute /var or file:// paths.
asi.result: Strengthened 22-check workload found one failure: a cwd-contained './.auto/tmp-rel-images-*/relative Screen Shot.png' path does not render/sanitize.
asi.failing_case: Explicit ./ relative image path with spaces remains unrecognized; previous relative-to-/var case passed only via absolute suffix matching.

description: support explicit cwd-relative image paths in prompt thumbnail extraction and display cleanup

asi.hypothesis: Resolving explicit ./ and ../ image paths against process.cwd() and teaching the path extractor to recognize relative prefixes will make pi-island match pi's cwd-relative path behavior without probing arbitrary bare filenames.
asi.result: Cwd-relative path workload passes: failures 1 -> 0 across 22 prompt-image checks.
asi.implementation_note: normalizePromptImagePath now resolves only explicit relative prefixes; extension/path-prefix regexes include . and .. prefixes so relative paths with spaces are extracted and removed from hover display.

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (duplicate raw path variants)

description: baseline for duplicate raw path variants: display removes only first de-duped raw occurrence

asi.hypothesis: Duplicate raw references to the same image can appear in different textual forms (literal spaces and shell-escaped spaces). Thumbnails should de-dupe by resolved path, while hover display should remove every raw occurrence.
asi.result: New 23-check workload has one display failure. Thumbnail extraction de-dupes correctly (count=1/images=1), but display cleanup leaves one raw variant because generic path elision uses de-duped matches.
asi.failing_case: Prompt with both `/tmp/Screen Shot.png` and `/tmp/Screen\\ Shot.png` leaves the shell-escaped path text in hover display.

description: remove every duplicate raw path variant from hover display while preserving thumbnail de-dupe

asi.hypothesis: Generic hover display path elision should use non-deduped path spans, just like Markdown cleanup, so every textual occurrence is removed even when thumbnail extraction de-dupes by resolved path.
asi.result: Duplicate raw path variants workload passes: failures 1 -> 0 across 23 prompt-image checks.
asi.implementation_note: normalizePromptForDisplay now calls extractPromptImagePathMatches(display, {dedupe:false}) for final raw path elision; normalizePromptImages remains on default de-duped extraction for thumbnail count.

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (HTML img tags)

description: baseline for HTML img tag workload: thumbnails render but hover display leaves broken img markup

asi.hypothesis: Rich clipboard or issue content may contain HTML tags with local image src paths; pi-island should render the image and show clean alt text instead of broken tag markup.
asi.result: New 25-check workload has two display failures. Extraction works (count=1/images=1), but display text leaves `` or ``.
failing_cases: `` displays as ``
`` displays as ``

description: normalize local HTML img tags to alt text in hover display

asi.hypothesis: HTML tags with local image src paths should behave like Markdown image references: thumbnail extraction uses the src, and hover prompt display keeps only useful alt text.
asi.result: HTML img tag workload passes: failures 2 -> 0 across 25 prompt-image checks.
asi.implementation_note: Added htmlAttrValue() and normalizeHtmlLocalImageTagsForDisplay(); normalizePromptForDisplay now replaces local tags with trimmed alt text before generic path/tag elision.

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (@-prefixed paths)

description: baseline for @-prefixed image path workload: thumbnails render but hover leaves stray @

asi.hypothesis: Pi's path UX often uses @path syntax; @-prefixed local image paths should render as thumbnails and the whole @path token should disappear from hover display.
asi.result: New 27-check workload has two display failures. Extraction works for absolute and relative @ paths, but display elision removes only the path portion, leaving stray @ characters.
failing_cases: `inspect @./.auto/tmp-rel-images-*/relative Screen Shot.png please` leaves `@` in hover display

description: support @-prefixed local image paths without leaving stray @ in hover display

asi.hypothesis: Treat @ as path decoration when it directly prefixes a supported local image path prefix, and include it in raw path spans so hover display removes the whole token while extraction still resolves the image.
asi.result: @-prefixed path workload passes: failures 2 -> 0 across 27 prompt-image checks.
asi.implementation_note: normalizePromptImagePath strips a leading @ only before supported path prefixes; extraction regexes include optional @ so final display elision removes @/tmp and @./relative tokens completely.

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (HTML anchor image links)

description: baseline for HTML anchor image links: thumbnails render but hover leaves broken anchor markup

asi.hypothesis: Rich clipboard or issue content may contain HTML anchors linking to local screenshots; pi-island should render those hrefs as thumbnails and show clean link text in hover display.
asi.result: New 29-check workload has two display failures. Extraction works for local path and file:// hrefs, but display cleanup leaves `text` markup.
failing_cases: `linked screenshot` displays as `linked screenshot`

description: normalize local HTML anchor image links to link text in hover display

asi.hypothesis: HTML anchors whose href resolves to a local image should behave like Markdown links: thumbnail extraction uses the href while hover display keeps only readable link text.
asi.result: HTML anchor image link workload passes: failures 2 -> 0 across 29 prompt-image checks.
asi.implementation_note: Added normalizeHtmlLocalImageAnchorsForDisplay(); normalizePromptForDisplay now replaces local-image ... tags with stripped inner link text before generic path elision.

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (HTML img srcset)

description: baseline for HTML img srcset workload: thumbnail renders but hover leaves broken img srcset markup

asi.hypothesis: Rich HTML image markup may use srcset instead of src; pi-island should render local srcset images and show clean alt text.
asi.result: New 30-check workload has one display failure. Extraction works (count=1/images=1), but display cleanup leaves ``.
asi.failing_case: `` displays as ``.

description: normalize local HTML img srcset entries to alt text in hover display

asi.hypothesis: HTML img tags that use srcset rather than src should behave like src images: thumbnail extraction uses the local srcset URL/path and hover display keeps only alt text.
asi.result: HTML img srcset workload passes: failures 1 -> 0 across 30 prompt-image checks.
asi.implementation_note: Added htmlSrcsetHasLocalImage(); normalizeHtmlLocalImageTagsForDisplay now treats a local src or local srcset candidate as an image tag to replace with trimmed alt text.

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (HTML source tags)

description: baseline for HTML source tag workload: thumbnails render but hover leaves broken source markup

asi.hypothesis: HTML picture/source markup may reference local images via src or srcset; pi-island should render those paths as thumbnails and remove non-visible source tags from hover display.
asi.result: New 32-check workload has two display failures. Extraction works (count=1/images=1), but display cleanup leaves `<source srcset=" 1x" ...>` and `<source src= ...>` markup.
failing_cases: `<source src="/tmp/a.png" type="image/png">` displays as `<source src= type="image/png">`

description: remove local HTML source image tags from hover display

asi.hypothesis: Non-visible HTML <source> tags that reference local images should be used for thumbnail extraction but removed from hover prompt display rather than leaving broken markup.
asi.result: HTML source tag workload passes: failures 2 -> 0 across 32 prompt-image checks.
asi.implementation_note: Added normalizeHtmlLocalImageSourceTagsForDisplay(); normalizePromptForDisplay now removes <source> tags whose src or srcset resolves to a local image before generic path elision.

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (multi-candidate srcset count)

description: baseline for multi-candidate HTML srcset: density candidates produce duplicate thumbnails

asi.hypothesis: HTML srcset lists multiple density/width candidates for one semantic image; pi-island should display a single thumbnail for the tag while preserving clean alt text.
asi.result: New 33-check workload has one failure: display is clean, but normalizePromptImages counts two local srcset candidates as two thumbnails.
asi.failing_case: `` yields count=2/images=2 instead of one semantic attachment.

description: dedupe multi-candidate HTML srcset groups as one semantic thumbnail

asi.hypothesis: Multiple local srcset candidates inside one img/source tag are alternate renditions of one semantic image and should not produce multiple island thumbnails.
asi.result: Multi-candidate srcset workload passes: failures 1 -> 0 across 33 prompt-image checks.
asi.implementation_note: Added htmlSrcsetLocalImagePaths() and extractHtmlImageCandidateGroups(); normalizePromptImages now keeps only the first local path inside each multi-candidate img/source tag while display normalization still uses alt/text cleanup.

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (percent-encoded local paths)

description: baseline for percent-encoded local paths: encoded space path is not resolved

asi.hypothesis: Clipboard/browser flows may emit percent-encoded local paths without a file:// prefix; pi-island should decode them to real local files and remove the encoded token from hover display.
asi.result: New 34-check workload has one failure: `/tmp/Screen%20Shot.png` does not render/sanitize even though `/tmp/Screen Shot.png` exists.
asi.failing_case: Percent-encoded local path with %20 spaces is treated as a literal filename and fails stat/MIME lookup.

description: resolve percent-encoded local image paths after literal path fallback

asi.hypothesis: Percent-encoded local paths should be decoded only if the literal path does not exist, preserving literal percent filenames while supporting browser-style /tmp/Screen%20Shot.png tokens.
asi.result: Percent-encoded local path workload passes: failures 1 -> 0 across 34 prompt-image checks.
asi.implementation_note: normalizePromptImagePath now first tries the literal resolved path, then decodeURI(s) as a fallback when the literal path fails and the token contains percent escapes.

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (query/fragment local paths)

description: baseline for query/fragment local image paths: thumbnails render but hover leaves URL suffix clutter

asi.hypothesis: Browser/devtools copied local image paths may include query strings or fragments; pi-island should resolve the base local file and remove the entire URL-ish token from hover text.
asi.result: New 36-check workload has two failures. Base thumbnail extraction works, but raw display elision removes only the base path and leaves '?cache=123#frag'; Markdown wrapper cleanup also fails to recognize the closing ')' after the suffix.
failing_cases: Raw `/tmp/a.png?cache=123#frag` leaves query/fragment clutter in hover display.
Markdown `![query shot](/tmp/a.png?cache=123#frag)` does not collapse to clean alt text.

description: strip URL query and fragment suffixes when resolving and hiding local image paths

asi.hypothesis: Local image paths with cache-busting query/fragment suffixes should resolve via their base file only after literal lookup, and display cleanup should remove the whole URL-ish token.
asi.result: Query/fragment local path workload passes: failures 2 -> 0 across 36 prompt-image checks.
asi.implementation_note: normalizePromptImagePath now tries literal/decoded path first, then falls back to the base before ?/#. Image-extension raw spans include optional query/fragment suffixes so hover display and Markdown cleanup remove the complete token.

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (HTML picture alternatives)

description: baseline for HTML picture alternatives: source+img render as duplicate thumbnails and leave picture wrappers

asi.hypothesis: HTML picture blocks represent one semantic image with multiple source/img alternatives; pi-island should show one thumbnail and clean hover text using the img alt label.
asi.result: New 37-check workload has one failure: `` counts two thumbnails and displays ` alt `.
asi.failing_case: Picture block with local source srcset and local img src yields count=2/images=2 and leaves picture wrapper markup.

description: dedupe HTML picture source/img alternatives as one thumbnail and remove picture wrappers

asi.hypothesis: HTML picture blocks contain alternate sources for one semantic image; grouping local img/source candidates across the whole picture should prevent duplicate thumbnails, and display cleanup should remove picture wrapper tags.
asi.result: HTML picture alternatives workload passes: failures 1 -> 0 across 37 prompt-image checks.
asi.implementation_note: Added htmlLocalImagePathsFromTag(), picture-level candidate grouping in extractHtmlImageCandidateGroups(), and normalizeHtmlPictureWrappersForDisplay(); normalizePromptImages now keeps only the first local path inside each picture block.

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (mixed direct image plus file tags)

description: baseline for mixed direct image plus separate CLI file tag: file tag image is skipped

asi.hypothesis: A prompt may contain a direct pasted ImageContent plus a separate CLI/file-argument image tag; pi-island should de-dupe only file tags that mirror a direct image, not all file tags whenever any direct image exists.
asi.result: New 38-check workload has one failure: direct PNG ImageContent plus a separate GIF <file name=...> image counts only the direct thumbnail.
asi.failing_case: direct ImageContent + different image file tag yields count=1/images=1 instead of count=2/images=2 because the current skip is based only on direct image count and file tag position.

description: dedupe CLI image file tags by content so unrelated file-tag images are preserved

asi.hypothesis: File-tag fallback de-dupe should compare direct image bytes with file-tag image bytes; this skips only mirrored CLI tags while retaining separate local image attachments in the same prompt.
asi.result: Mixed direct image plus file-tag workload passes: failures 1 -> 0 across 38 prompt-image checks.
asi.implementation_note: normalizePromptImages now records SHA-256 hashes for accepted direct image payloads and skips an image <file name=...> fallback only when the file content hash matches a remaining direct image hash.

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (direct image plus raw path de-dupe)

description: baseline for direct image plus raw path de-dupe: matching raw path duplicates direct thumbnail

asi.hypothesis: Some paste/attach flows pass a direct ImageContent payload while prompt text also includes the same raw local temp path; pi-island should de-dupe same-content direct+raw references while still preserving different raw image paths.
asi.result: New 40-check workload has one failure: direct ImageContent plus matching raw local path yields duplicate thumbnails.
asi.failing_case: A direct PNG payload and prompt text containing the same PNG file path counts two thumbnails instead of one; direct PNG plus separate GIF raw path already keeps both.

description: dedupe raw local image paths against direct image payloads by content

asi.hypothesis: Generalizing the direct-image content hash check from CLI file tags to all prompt-extracted local image paths will prevent a direct pasted image plus its raw temp path from rendering as two thumbnails, while different raw-path content remains attached.
asi.result: Direct image plus matching raw local path now de-dupes, and direct image plus a separate GIF raw path still counts two thumbnails.
asi.implementation_note: normalizePromptImages now consumes a matching direct-image SHA-256 hash for any extracted local image file path before adding a path-derived thumbnail; HTML candidate group marking still happens first so alternate candidates remain grouped.

description: confirmation rerun of direct+raw de-dupe fix; zero failures reproduced

asi.hypothesis: Verify that the direct image plus raw local path de-dupe fix is stable across another run of the 40-check workload.
asi.result: All 40 prompt image attachment assertions passed again with failures=0.
asi.rollback_reason: No code change in this confirmation run and the primary metric tied the kept best.
asi.next_action_hint: Consider broadening coverage for direct-image de-dupe through equivalent textual forms such as file:// URLs, percent-encoded paths, query/fragment suffixes, and Markdown/HTML wrappers.

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (direct image plus HTML srcset alternatives)

description: baseline for direct image plus HTML srcset alternatives: non-first matching candidate duplicates

asi.hypothesis: A rich clipboard prompt can include a direct ImageContent payload plus an HTML srcset group where the direct image corresponds to a non-first candidate; because srcset candidates are one semantic image, any candidate matching a direct image should suppress the whole group.
asi.result: New 41-check workload has one failure: a direct PNG plus an whose first candidate is a different GIF and second candidate is the same PNG counts two thumbnails.
asi.failing_case: `` with matching direct ImageContent yields count=2/images=2 instead of count=1/images=1, although hover display is clean.

description: dedupe direct images against any candidate in an HTML srcset group

asi.hypothesis: For HTML img/source/picture groups, direct-image de-dupe should be semantic at the group level: if any local candidate in the group matches a direct ImageContent payload by bytes, skip the entire group instead of adding the first candidate as another thumbnail.
asi.result: The 41-check workload now passes with failures 1 -> 0; direct PNG plus an whose second candidate matches the direct image renders one thumbnail and keeps clean hover alt text.
asi.implementation_note: Added consumeDirectImageMatchForFiles() and moved direct-image hash consumption inside the htmlGroup branch so all paths in an HTML candidate group are checked before deciding whether to add a path-derived thumbnail.

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (direct image plus same-content raw copies)

description: baseline for direct image plus multiple same-content raw paths: second fallback duplicates

asi.hypothesis: Clipboard/attach plumbing can mention the same direct pasted image through multiple local temp files; all same-content raw path fallbacks should be suppressed, while different-content raw images still render separately.
asi.result: New 42-check workload has one failure: direct PNG plus two same-content raw local image paths counts two thumbnails.
asi.failing_case: A direct PNG payload with two different PNG temp paths containing identical bytes yields count=2/images=2 instead of count=1/images=1; hover display already hides both paths.

description: treat direct-image hash matches as non-consuming so all same-content raw fallbacks are skipped

asi.hypothesis: A direct pasted image can be referenced through multiple same-content local temp paths; direct-image de-dupe should be a membership check rather than consuming the one direct hash after the first fallback.
asi.result: The 42-check workload now passes with failures 1 -> 0. Direct PNG plus two different same-content PNG temp paths renders one thumbnail, while the existing direct PNG plus different GIF raw path still renders two.
asi.implementation_note: Renamed the helper to hasDirectImageMatchForFile(s) and stopped decrementing directImageHashes when a path fallback matches, so all same-content file/path/html fallbacks are suppressed against an existing direct image payload.

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (duplicate direct image payloads)

description: baseline for duplicate direct image payloads: same bytes render twice

asi.hypothesis: Some paste/attach event plumbing can deliver the same direct ImageContent payload twice; identical direct image bytes should de-dupe while distinct direct images still render separately.
asi.result: New 44-check workload has one failure: two identical direct PNG ImageContent entries count as two thumbnails.
asi.failing_case: `evt.images=[png,png]` yields count=2/images=2 instead of count=1/images=1; `evt.images=[png,gif]` already counts two as expected.

description: de-dupe duplicate direct ImageContent payloads by content hash

asi.hypothesis: Direct ImageContent payloads should use the same content-hash de-dupe as path/file fallbacks so duplicated event entries do not render duplicate thumbnails, while distinct direct image bytes remain separate attachments.
asi.result: The 44-check workload now passes with failures 1 -> 0. Identical direct PNG payloads render one thumbnail and distinct PNG+GIF direct payloads still render two.
asi.implementation_note: normalizePromptImages now computes the direct image SHA-256 before normalizing each direct entry and skips already-seen hashes; the direct hash set is still used to suppress same-content path/file/html fallbacks.

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (self-closing CLI image file tags)

description: baseline for self-closing CLI image file tags: hover leaves empty file markup

asi.hypothesis: Some XML-ish CLI/file-argument prompts may use self-closing <file name="..." /> tags for image attachments; these should render as fallback thumbnails and be removed from hover display just like paired <file></file> tags.
asi.result: New 45-check workload has one failure: the self-closing file tag renders via generic quoted path extraction, but display cleanup leaves `<file name= />` markup.
asi.failing_case: `<file name="/tmp/image.png" />` yields count=1/images=1 but hover text `describe self-closing image <file name= /> please inspect it`.

description: recognize self-closing image file tags and remove whole marker from hover display

asi.hypothesis: Image file-tag detection should support both paired and self-closing XML-ish forms so fallback rendering and hover cleanup treat them as attachment metadata, not prompt text.
asi.result: The 45-check workload now passes with failures 1 -> 0; self-closing `<file name="/tmp/image.png" />` renders one thumbnail and no longer leaves `<file name= />` in hover text.
asi.implementation_note: Updated extractPromptImageFileTagMatches() to match `<file ... />` as well as `<file ...></file>` while still normalizing only tags whose name resolves to a real local image.

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (CLI file tag attribute order)

description: baseline for CLI file tag attribute order: file markup remains when name is not first

asi.hypothesis: CLI/file-argument image tags are XML-ish metadata and may include attributes before name; detection should not depend on name being the first attribute.
asi.result: New 46-check workload has one failure: a <file type="image/png" name="/tmp/image.png"></file> tag renders via generic path fallback, but hover cleanup leaves broken file markup.
asi.failing_case: Display becomes `describe file metadata <file type="image/png" name= ></file> please inspect it` instead of removing the whole image file marker.

description: parse image file tags independent of attribute order

asi.hypothesis: Treat <file> markers as XML-ish attachment metadata by reading the opening tag's name attribute regardless of attribute order, while preserving paired and self-closing forms.
asi.result: The 46-check workload now passes with failures 1 -> 0; <file type="image/png" name="/tmp/image.png"></file> renders one thumbnail and is removed entirely from hover display.
asi.implementation_note: extractPromptImageFileTagMatches() now matches the whole <file> marker first and uses htmlAttrValue(openTag, 'name') instead of requiring name to be the first attribute in the regex.

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (HTML entity-escaped image attributes)

description: baseline for HTML entity-escaped image attributes: escaped ampersand path is not resolved

asi.hypothesis: Rich clipboard HTML can entity-escape local image attributes (for example ampersands in filenames or alt text); pi-island should decode those attributes for image resolution and clean hover text.
asi.result: New 47-check workload has one failure: does not render and remains as raw HTML in hover text.
asi.failing_case: A real local file named `R&D Screen Shot.png` referenced as `R&D Screen Shot.png` yields count=0/images=0 and hover displays the full tag.

description: decode HTML entity-escaped image attribute paths and alt text

asi.hypothesis: Rich clipboard HTML may entity-escape local image attribute values; resolving image paths should try HTML-entity-decoded fallbacks after literal lookup, and hover labels should decode common entities.
asi.result: The 47-check workload now passes with failures 1 -> 0; renders one thumbnail and hover displays decoded alt text without the raw tag.
asi.implementation_note: Added decodeHtmlEntities(), used it as a fallback in normalizePromptImagePath(), and made htmlAttrValue() return decoded attribute values so both path resolution and display labels handle escaped rich-clipboard HTML.

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (HTML anchor entity-escaped link text)

description: baseline for HTML anchor entity text: image renders but hover keeps escaped link text

asi.hypothesis: After decoding rich HTML image attribute values, local-image anchors can still carry entity-escaped visible text; hover display should decode that link text as well.
asi.result: New 48-check workload has one failure: an R&D screenshot renders one thumbnail, but hover text remains `R&D screenshot`.
asi.failing_case: Local-image anchor with entity-escaped href/text yields count=1/images=1 and display `see R&D screenshot now` instead of decoded `R&D` text.

description: decode entity-escaped text preserved from local-image anchors

asi.hypothesis: When replacing local-image HTML anchors with their visible link text, the preserved text should be entity-decoded just like image alt attributes, so rich clipboard markup does not leak `&` into hover display.
asi.result: The 48-check workload now passes with failures 1 -> 0; entity-escaped local-image anchor hrefs still render one thumbnail and hover displays decoded `R&D screenshot`.
asi.implementation_note: normalizeHtmlLocalImageAnchorsForDisplay() now wraps its stripped inner text with decodeHtmlEntities() before returning it for the prompt hover preview.

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (Markdown entity-escaped local image refs)

description: baseline for Markdown entity-escaped local image refs: thumbnail renders but alt stays escaped

asi.hypothesis: Markdown pasted from rich sources can entity-escape both local image paths and labels; after path decoding allows the thumbnail to render, hover display should decode the preserved Markdown alt/link text too.
asi.result: New 49-check workload has one failure: `![R&D screenshot](.../R&D Screen Shot.png)` renders one thumbnail but hover text remains `R&D screenshot`.
asi.failing_case: Markdown local-image reference with entity-escaped path/alt yields count=1/images=1 and display `see R&D screenshot before fixing` instead of decoded `R&D` text.

description: decode entity-escaped labels preserved from Markdown local image refs

asi.hypothesis: Markdown local-image display cleanup should decode HTML entities in preserved alt/link labels, matching the entity decoding already added for HTML image alt text and anchor text.
asi.result: The 49-check workload now passes with failures 1 -> 0; entity-escaped Markdown local image paths still render one thumbnail and hover displays decoded `R&D screenshot`.
asi.implementation_note: normalizeMarkdownLocalImageReferencesForDisplay() now wraps the trimmed Markdown label with decodeHtmlEntities() before inserting it into the hover prompt.

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (paired HTML img tags)

description: baseline for paired HTML img tags: closing tag remains after hover cleanup

asi.hypothesis: Rich clipboard or XHTML-ish content may serialize local images as paired ; pi-island should render the thumbnail and remove the whole paired markup, not leave a stray closing tag in hover text.
asi.result: New 50-check workload has one failure: paired renders one thumbnail but hover displays `paired img `.
asi.failing_case: normalizeHtmlLocalImageTagsForDisplay() currently replaces only the opening tag, leaving closing clutter.

description: remove optional paired closing img tags during local image hover cleanup

asi.hypothesis: Local HTML image display cleanup should consume XHTML-style paired markup as one attachment marker, preserving alt text without leaving stray closing tags.
asi.result: The 50-check workload now passes with failures 1 -> 0; paired local renders one thumbnail and hover text contains clean `paired img` with no ``.
asi.implementation_note: normalizeHtmlLocalImageTagsForDisplay() now matches an optional immediate closing </img> after the opening tag before replacing local image markup with alt text.

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (paired HTML source tags)

description: baseline for paired HTML source tags: closing tag remains after hover cleanup

asi.hypothesis: Rich clipboard or XHTML-ish picture markup may serialize local source candidates as paired <source ...></source>; pi-island should render the thumbnail and remove the whole source marker, not leave a stray closing tag in hover text.
asi.result: New 51-check workload has one failure: paired <source src="/tmp/image.png"></source> renders one thumbnail but hover displays `</source>`.
asi.failing_case: normalizeHtmlLocalImageSourceTagsForDisplay() currently removes only the opening <source> tag, leaving closing </source> clutter.

description: remove optional paired closing source tags during local source hover cleanup

asi.hypothesis: Local HTML source display cleanup should consume XHTML-style paired markup as one attachment marker, matching the paired handling and avoiding stray closing tags in hover text.
asi.result: The 51-check workload now passes with failures 1 -> 0; paired local <source src="/tmp/image.png"></source> renders one thumbnail and hover text contains no `</source>` clutter.
asi.implementation_note: normalizeHtmlLocalImageSourceTagsForDisplay() now matches an optional immediate closing </source> after the opening local source tag before replacing it with whitespace.

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (Markdown local image titles)

description: baseline for Markdown local image titles: hover leaves markdown wrapper and title

asi.hypothesis: Markdown local image/link syntax can include an optional title after the target; pi-island should still collapse the whole local-image wrapper to alt/link text after rendering the thumbnail.
asi.result: New 52-check workload has one failure: `![titled shot](/tmp/image.png "local screenshot title")` renders one thumbnail, but hover display leaves `![titled shot]( "local screenshot title")`.
asi.failing_case: Markdown cleanup only recognizes a closing `)` immediately after the path (or angle wrapper), so optional titles prevent wrapper cleanup.

description: handle optional Markdown titles when cleaning local image refs

asi.hypothesis: Markdown local-image display cleanup should recognize optional titles after local image targets and remove the full wrapper/title while preserving the useful alt or link label.
asi.result: The 52-check workload now passes with failures 1 -> 0; `![titled shot](/tmp/image.png "local screenshot title")` renders one thumbnail and hover displays clean `titled shot` text without title/path clutter.
asi.implementation_note: normalizeMarkdownLocalImageReferencesForDisplay() now accepts optional quoted, single-quoted, or parenthesized Markdown title text between the resolved path (or angle-wrapped path) and the closing parenthesis.

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (direct data URL image payloads)

description: baseline for direct data URL image payloads: MIME is not inferred

asi.hypothesis: Some direct image event payloads may carry a data:image/...;base64 URL in `data` without a separate mimeType field; pi-island should infer the MIME from the data URL and render it as a direct attachment.
asi.result: New 53-check workload has one failure: `{type:'image', data:'data:image/png;base64,...'}` yields count=0/images=0 because normalizePromptImageObject requires an explicit mimeType.
asi.failing_case: Direct data URL ImageContent with embedded image/png MIME is ignored instead of rendering one thumbnail.

description: infer MIME for direct image data URL payloads

asi.hypothesis: Direct image payload normalization should infer image MIME from embedded data:image/... URLs when explicit mimeType/mediaType fields are missing, so data URL ImageContent still renders and participates in content-hash de-dupe.
asi.result: The 53-check workload now passes with failures 1 -> 0; `{type:'image', data:'data:image/png;base64,...'}` renders one image/png thumbnail.
asi.implementation_note: Added promptImageMimeFromDataUrl() and used it in promptImageHashFromObject() and normalizePromptImageObject() for direct `data` and base64 `source.data` payloads when explicit MIME metadata is absent.

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (direct image_url data URL payloads)

description: baseline for direct image_url data URL payloads: OpenAI-style image object is ignored

asi.hypothesis: Some direct image event payloads may use the common OpenAI-style `{type:'image_url', image_url:{url:'data:image/...'}}` shape; pi-island should treat local/data image_url payloads as direct attachments without fetching remote URLs.
asi.result: New 54-check workload has one failure: an image_url data URL payload yields count=0/images=0 because direct image normalization only accepts `{type:'image'}` objects.
asi.failing_case: `{type:'image_url', image_url:{url:'data:image/png;base64,...'}}` is ignored instead of rendering one image/png thumbnail.

description: support OpenAI-style direct image_url data URL payloads

asi.hypothesis: Direct image payload normalization should accept common OpenAI-style image_url objects when their URL is a local file or data:image URL, rendering them as direct attachments without attempting remote network fetches.
asi.result: The 54-check workload now passes with failures 1 -> 0; `{type:'image_url', image_url:{url:'data:image/png;base64,...'}}` renders one image/png thumbnail.
asi.implementation_note: Added promptImageUrlFromObject() and image_url branches in promptImageHashFromObject() and normalizePromptImageObject(); data:image URLs are decoded like other direct base64 payloads, while local file/file:// URLs resolve through normalizePromptImagePath().

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (direct image source URL payloads)

description: baseline for direct image source URL payloads: local file URL source is ignored

asi.hypothesis: Some direct image payloads may use `{type:'image', source:{type:'url', url:'file:///...'}}` rather than base64 source data; local/data source URLs should render without fetching remote URLs.
asi.result: New 55-check workload has one failure: `{type:'image', source:{type:'url', url:'file:///tmp/image.png'}}` yields count=0/images=0 because only source.type='base64' is handled.
asi.failing_case: A direct image source URL pointing at a readable local PNG file is ignored instead of rendering one image/png thumbnail.

description: support direct image source URL payloads for local/data images

asi.hypothesis: Direct image payload normalization should accept `{type:'image', source:{type:'url', url:'file:///...'}}` and data:image source URLs as direct attachments, sharing the same local/data URL logic as image_url objects without fetching remote URLs.
asi.result: The 55-check workload now passes with failures 1 -> 0; a direct image source URL pointing at a local PNG renders one image/png thumbnail.
asi.implementation_note: Added promptImageHashFromUrl() and makePromptImageFromUrl() helpers, reused them for image_url objects, and added source.type='url' branches in promptImageHashFromObject() and normalizePromptImageObject().

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (direct input_image data URL payloads)

description: baseline for direct input_image data URL payloads: Responses-style image object is ignored

asi.hypothesis: Some direct image payloads may use OpenAI Responses-style `{type:'input_image', image_url:'data:image/...'}` content parts; pi-island should treat local/data input_image payloads as direct attachments without fetching remote URLs.
asi.result: New 56-check workload has one failure: an input_image data URL payload yields count=0/images=0 because direct URL image normalization only accepts image_url objects and image/source shapes.
asi.failing_case: `{type:'input_image', image_url:'data:image/png;base64,...'}` is ignored instead of rendering one image/png thumbnail.

description: support OpenAI Responses-style input_image data URL payloads

asi.hypothesis: Direct image payload normalization should accept OpenAI Responses-style input_image content parts when their image_url is a local or data:image URL, reusing the existing no-fetch URL image path.
asi.result: The 56-check workload now passes with failures 1 -> 0; `{type:'input_image', image_url:'data:image/png;base64,...'}` renders one image/png thumbnail.
asi.implementation_note: promptImageHashFromObject() and normalizePromptImageObject() now route both image_url and input_image payload types through promptImageUrlFromObject(), promptImageHashFromUrl(), and makePromptImageFromUrl().

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (Markdown reference-style local images)

description: baseline for Markdown reference-style local images: thumbnail renders but reference clutter remains

asi.hypothesis: Markdown pasted from issue trackers can use reference-style local image definitions; pi-island should render the referenced local image and collapse the visible reference usage to alt/link text while removing the local reference definition.
asi.result: New 57-check workload has one failure: `![reference shot][shot]` with `[shot]: /tmp/image.png "title"` renders one thumbnail, but hover text leaves `![reference shot][shot] [shot]: "title"` clutter.
asi.failing_case: Reference-style local image definitions are not recognized by normalizeMarkdownLocalImageReferencesForDisplay(); generic path elision removes only the path from the definition.

description: clean Markdown reference-style local image definitions and usages

asi.hypothesis: Markdown reference-style local image definitions should behave like inline local image syntax: render the referenced local image as a thumbnail, remove the local reference definition as attachment metadata, and preserve only readable alt/link text in hover display.
asi.result: The 57-check workload now passes with failures 1 -> 0; `![reference shot][shot]` plus `[shot]: /tmp/image.png "title"` renders one thumbnail and hover displays clean `reference shot` text without definition/title/path clutter.
asi.implementation_note: normalizeMarkdownLocalImageReferencesForDisplay() now detects reference definitions whose target resolves to a local image, removes those definition lines, and replaces explicit `![alt][id]` / `[label][id]` usages with decoded label text before inline Markdown cleanup runs.

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (Markdown shortcut reference local images)

description: baseline for Markdown shortcut reference local images: usage bracket remains

asi.hypothesis: Markdown reference-style local images can use shortcut syntax `![alt]` with a matching `[alt]: /tmp/image.png` definition; hover cleanup should remove the local definition and collapse the shortcut usage to alt text.
asi.result: New 58-check workload has one failure: shortcut reference renders one thumbnail and removes the definition, but hover display leaves `![shortcut shot]` markup.
asi.failing_case: `![shortcut shot]` plus `[shortcut shot]: /tmp/image.png "title"` displays as `see![shortcut shot] now` instead of clean `shortcut shot` text.

description: clean Markdown shortcut reference local image usages

asi.hypothesis: Shortcut reference-style Markdown local images should be cleaned like explicit reference-style images: remove the local image definition and replace the shortcut image usage with readable decoded label text.
asi.result: The 58-check workload now passes with failures 1 -> 0; `![shortcut shot]` plus `[shortcut shot]: /tmp/image.png "title"` renders one thumbnail and hover displays clean `shortcut shot` text.
asi.implementation_note: normalizeMarkdownLocalImageReferencesForDisplay() now replaces shortcut `![label]` / `[label]` usages whose label key matches a local-image reference definition after explicit `[label][id]` usages are handled.

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (direct image MIME field aliases)

description: baseline for direct image MIME field aliases: media_type payload is ignored

asi.hypothesis: Direct image payloads can use different MIME metadata field names such as media_type or mediaType; pi-island should accept these aliases for direct base64 images instead of requiring only mimeType.
asi.result: New 59-check workload has one failure: `{type:'image', data:base64, media_type:'image/png'}` yields count=0/images=0 because direct normalization only reads top-level mimeType.
asi.failing_case: Top-level media_type direct ImageContent is ignored instead of rendering one image/png thumbnail.

description: accept common MIME metadata aliases for direct image payloads

asi.hypothesis: Direct/base64 image payload normalization should accept common MIME field aliases (mimeType, mediaType, media_type, mime_type) before falling back to data URL MIME inference, so event shape differences do not drop image attachments.
asi.result: The 59-check workload now passes with failures 1 -> 0; `{type:'image', data:base64, media_type:'image/png'}` renders one image/png thumbnail.
asi.implementation_note: Added promptImageMimeFromMetadata() and used it for both top-level direct image objects and nested source objects in promptImageHashFromObject() and normalizePromptImageObject().

name: Fix pi-island prompt image attachment rendering (HTML figure local images)

description: baseline for HTML figure local images: figure/caption tags remain in hover

asi.hypothesis: Rich clipboard HTML can wrap local screenshots in <figure>/<figcaption>; after rendering the image thumbnail, hover text should keep readable alt/caption text without raw figure markup.
asi.result: New 60-check workload has one failure: renders one thumbnail but hover displays raw
asi.failing_case: normalizeHtmlLocalImageTagsForDisplay() replaces only the with alt text; figure and figcaption wrapper tags remain as UI clutter.

description: strip HTML figure and figcaption wrappers around local images in hover text

asi.hypothesis: Rich clipboard HTML can wrap local screenshots in figure/figcaption elements; after rendering the image thumbnail, hover text should preserve readable alt/caption content without raw wrapper tags.
asi.result: The 60-check workload now passes with failures 1 -> 0; renders one thumbnail and hover displays clean figure/caption text.
asi.implementation_note: Added normalizeHtmlFigureWrappersForDisplay() and invoke it after local img/source/picture normalization, stripping figure and figcaption tags while leaving their readable text content.
